default.detail: A 30-minute call to understand the work, the people, and the deadline. You leave with a clear sense of scope and a plain answer on whether SunRiver is the right fit.
A written scope with milestones, a fixed price, and a timeline. No surprises, no padded hours. You own every recurring cost we set up on your behalf.
Weekly progress you can actually see. Each milestone ships something real, gets reviewed together, and moves the project forward in the open.
We ship it, hand over the keys, and document how it runs. Most clients move into a light monthly retainer so the work keeps paying off.
